Cottage Breeze by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Cottage Breeze, your happy place in Seacrest. Tucked between the buzz of Rosemary Beach and the calm of Watersound, this three-bedroom, three-bath cottage is ready for laid-back days and salty hair. Start your morning with a quick walk to the private beach access and let the Gulf wake you up. When the sun gets high, cool off in the community pool or soak in the hot tub like you’re on permanent vacation. Ready to explore? Hop on one of the three complimentary bikes and cruise over to Alys Beach or Rosemary Beach for coffee runs, boutique browsing, or lunch at The Big Chill. There’s always something happening along 30A. After a day of sand and sunshine, kick back on the balcony with an evening cocktail or gather inside to cheer on your team or watch a movie together.

With its clean coastal style and comfy layout, Cottage Breeze makes it easy to settle in and feel at home. Located just four blocks west of Watersound Parkway, it’s close to everything you love about 30A – but still feels like your own private escape. Oversee 30A is here to keep everything running smoothly. Our local team is available seven days a week, with a 24/7 emergency line if you need us. Overview: - 250 steps to the beach (Private Deeded Access) - 3 bedrooms, 3 baths - 1,444 sq ft - Community pool with hot tub - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: Queen bed, shared bath SECOND FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: King bed, private bath, private balcony - Bunk Room: Twin over twin bunk and twin bed, shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
